payload.reason: The evidence specifies the use of a deep learning model for sentence segmentation, particularly mentioning the Bi-LSTM-CRF model and its enhancements with n-gram embedding and self-attention modules.

claims.text: The deep learning architecture used for sentence segmentation is the Bi-LSTM-CRF model, which integrates n-gram embedding and self-attention modules.
The model also utilizes Cross-View Training (CVT) as a semi-supervised learning technique to improve performance with unlabeled data.
